summary.business_type: Affiliate/review publisher (pet gadgets, pt-BR), static HTML, 72 posts / 78 URLs
top_findings: Ranking bottleneck still page-type mismatch: coleira GPS and câmera 'melhor' pages lack multi-product Top-N (SXO gap 63/100, up from 60)
False testing claim 'Testamos 3 comedouros' on comedouro-vdrbg-4l-wifi-review + contradictory bylines on 61 pages (E-E-A-T)
Thin clusters: camera/brinquedo/porta median ~500 body words, FAQs duplicate body
/melhor-comedouro-automatico-cachorro/ fell pos 7.7 -> 21.6 (before the 10-22 update; overlaps Sept 2026 Spam Update — hypothesis only)
Homepage mobile horizontal scroll (fixed locally, pending deploy)
quick_wins: Trim tapete title/description; fix R$ per-unit numbers
Resubmit sitemap in GSC; enable CrUX API

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: IndexNow key live; robots.txt AI policy with Content-Signal

findings.title: Homepage horizontal scroll on mobile
findings.description: nav.main-nav rendered 445px wide on a 375px viewport (non-wrapping flex row: logo + 4 links, gap 22px); 'Contato' cut off. Fixed theme toggle also overlapped 'Contato' at <1180px.
findings.recommendation: FIXED LOCALLY 2026-10-23 in index.html (nav wraps below logo <=600px; header reserves 64px for toggle <=1200px). Verified 320-1440px. Pending deploy.

findings.title: http://www takes 2 redirect hops
findings.description: http://www.smartpetgadgets.com.br -> https://www -> https://apex.
findings.recommendation: Single 301 to https apex in .htaccess.

findings.title: Dirty working tree vs live
findings.description: Many uncommitted changes (comedouro posts, images, sitemap.xml, llms.txt, deploy.sh); live appears deployed from working tree.
findings.recommendation: Commit current state so git reflects production.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: melhor-tapete-higienico-para-cachorro rewrite is now the strongest page (7 products, table, ItemList)

findings.title: False first-hand testing claim
findings.description: comedouro-vdrbg-4l-wifi-review Key Takeaways: 'Testamos 3 comedouros automáticos de 4L' — contradicts the site's 'não testamos' disclosures (verified in source).
findings.recommendation: Rewrite as 'Comparamos 3 comedouros...' based on specs and reviews.

findings.title: Contradictory bylines
findings.description: 61 pages show 'Por Nildo Alves' and also 'Escrito pela Equipe Smart Pet Gadgets'; 52 author boxes say 'Testa e pesquisa produtos'.
findings.recommendation: Pick one attribution model; one template change across posts.

findings.title: Thin cluster content
findings.description: Camera, brinquedo interativo and porta eletrônica clusters: median body 473-530 words, ~320-350 excluding FAQs that repeat the body (overlap 0.88). 31/72 posts <600 words.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate or expand; rewrite FAQs to add new info instead of repeating.

findings.title: Tapete page price-per-unit inconsistency
findings.description: Luxena listed as 'menor preço por unidade R$ 0,92' while its own price R$ 42,23/50un = R$ 0,84; Biosec R$ 44/50 = R$ 0,88. Rating formula not stated; item 6 reviewBody cites 4.9 (ML buyer rating) next to 7.7 site score.
findings.recommendation: Recalculate per-unit prices, state scoring method, label ML rating.

findings.title: No first-hand experience evidence
findings.description: Flagship reviews have no own photos or measurements; /sobre/ and /politica-editorial/ don't explain AI use or rating method.
findings.recommendation: Add methodology section; disclose process.

findings.title: Comedouro cluster CTA/product depth
findings.description: Owner-paused rework; not re-flagged as actionable.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique titles, 1 H1 per page, self-canonicals

findings.title: Long titles/descriptions
findings.description: 6 titles >60 chars (tapete 67, coleira-gps-cachorro-que-foge 66); 3 descriptions >160 (tapete 170).
findings.recommendation: Trim to ~60 / ~155 chars.

findings.title: Weak internal linking
findings.description: 23 posts have <=3 internal links; generic anchors.
findings.recommendation: Run internal-linking skill and add descriptive anchors.

findings.title: Possible cannibalization
findings.description: /tapete-higienico-para-cachorro/ vs /melhor-tapete-higienico-para-cachorro/; camera-para-monitorar-pet vs melhor-camera-para-monitorar-pet.
findings.recommendation: Differentiate intent (guide vs Top-N) or consolidate with 301.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: All 78 pages valid JSON-LD; no HowTo/AggregateRating
New ItemList on tapete (7) and comedouro cachorro (7) valid

findings.title: Author Person lacks image
findings.description: /autores/nildo-alves/ Person has no image, one sameAs.
findings.recommendation: Add author photo and profile URLs.

findings.title: ItemList Products lack image/offers
findings.description: 7/7 on tapete, 3/7 on comedouro cachorro.
findings.recommendation: Add product images.

findings.title: worstRating inconsistency
findings.description: comedouro-newpet-2l-review uses worstRating 1 vs 0 elsewhere.
findings.recommendation: Normalize.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Lighthouse 100 on 10/10 runs; LCP 0.3-1.7s, TBT 0, CLS 0

findings.title: No field data (CrUX 403)
findings.description: CrUX API returns 403 for origin and URLs.
findings.recommendation: Enable Chrome UX Report API in the GCP project.

findings.title: Hero images lack fetchpriority
findings.description: Comedouro, coleira, antipulgas pages.
findings.recommendation: Add fetchpriority=high to hero img.

findings.title: Oversized home thumbnails
findings.description: Home cards 761 KiB mobile / 2,097 KiB desktop.
findings.recommendation: Serve smaller srcset thumbnails.

findings.title: Coleira GPS cluster names no products
findings.description: 0 products across 8 pages; melhor-coleira-gps-sem-mensalidade has no figures.
findings.recommendation: Add named product comparisons with specs/prices.

findings.title: Weak entity signals
findings.description: Organization.sameAs only Facebook; no Wikidata/YouTube/Reddit presence.
findings.recommendation: Add profiles and sameAs.

findings.title: llms.txt stale
findings.description: cerca-virtual-para-cachorro missing; tapete/comedouro descriptions outdated.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate llms.txt and .data/site-index.json.

findings.title: English-style citations in pt-BR text
findings.description: 122 'retrieved 2026-08-22' citations across 60 pages, many to competitor blogs, many unlinked.
findings.recommendation: Localize and link to primary sources.

findings.title: Hostinger 429 to GPTBot/Meta UA
findings.description: Spoofed-UA test only; training crawlers, not search.
findings.recommendation: Monitor in server logs.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All images have alt and dimensions; none broken

findings.title: Mobile comparison tables clipped
findings.description: Tapete table 527px in 343px wrapper, comedouro 645px; no scroll hint.
findings.recommendation: Add scroll hint/shadow or card layout on mobile.

findings.title: Literal '- ' bullets in takeaway boxes
findings.description: Tapete/VDRBG 'Key Takeaways' render hyphens as text.
findings.recommendation: Convert to <ul>.
